name: Context
review: Warokutal is a campground at Port Stewart in Lama Lama Country. Wet-season floods can damage the roads and other infrastructure (Engineers Without Borders Australia, 2024). Visitors are far from services, so a stuck vehicle can become an emergency. The Lama Lama Rangers manage tourism and carry out repairs (Reardon-Smith, 2023). Their time is limited.
author: Why this project matters
authorTitle: Warokutal (Safari Camp), Port Stewart, Lama Lama Country

name: How might we
review: How might we make a Lama Lama Country campground safer for visitors and more resilient to floods? The answer must cost little to build, add little work for Rangers, and protect cultural and ecological values.
